VitD regulates synaptic protein expression through VDR‐mediated transcriptional and translational control mechanisms

VitD regulates synaptic protein expression through VDR‐mediated transcriptional and translational control mechanisms. The schematic illustrates three molecular pathways by which VitD‐VDR signaling regulates synaptic protein expression: 1) Direct promoter binding to synaptic protein genes (e.g., Rab3a, Syt1; pathway 1); 2) Transcriptional control of translational regulators, including MNKs, initiation/elongation factors, and ribosomal proteins (pathway 2); 3) Modulation of mTOR signaling component (e.g., Lamtor2/5; pathway 3)
